copy.page_title: Limited Release Wines 2026-27 | Steins & Vines Squamish
copy.meta_description: Reserve this season's limited release wine kits from Winexpert and RJS at Steins & Vines in Squamish. Ten small-run wines, one released each month from November to April. $50 deposit per kit.
copy.hero_sub: Ten small-run wines from Winexpert and RJS, released one a month from November to April. Reserve yours with a $50 deposit. Once they're gone, they're gone.

how_it_works.text: Choose your kits and pay a $50 deposit for each.
We order your kit from the supplier for its release month.
When your kit arrives, we'll get in touch to book a time to start your batch.
Pay the rest of the kit price, less your deposit, plus the usual Maker's Fee and Materials Fee.

copy.price_note: Kit price shown. On brew day you'll also pay our Maker's Fee ($45) and Materials Fee ($5), plus applicable tax. Each batch makes 23 L, about 29 bottles.
deposit_terms: Deposits are $50 per kit and are non-refundable.
Your deposit comes off the kit price when you start your batch.
Release months are set by the suppliers and can change. We'll let you know if your kit is delayed.
If a supplier can't deliver a kit you've reserved, we'll refund that deposit in full.
We hold your kit for 60 days after it arrives. If you haven't started your batch by then, the deposit is forfeited.
Before your kit's release month, you can ask us to move your deposit to another limited release kit, subject to availability. Call or email us and we'll make the change.
copy.deposit_checkbox_label: I understand my $50 deposit per kit is non-refundable and will be applied to the kit price when I start my batch.
